attBesluta.text: Very happy with quality and ease of putting together
I bought this in September, its perfect size.love it.Many great uses.Easy lever to dump out debris. Rugged and well made. Highly recommend.

This is the second one of these I have purchased in the past couple of months. The first was for my use around the house moving plants, mulch and other projects. I just moved 2500 lbs crushed concrete for the base of a storage shed I purchased. I loaded it with approx. 300 lbs of crushed concrete each time and moved it with ease to my construction site in the back yard. The dump feature is a Great asset. I was so impressed with this item, I purchased one for my Son. I have been very happy with the VEVOR product. They have performed as advertised. I will be purchasing additional items as needed.

Excellent achat! Concernant la capacité annoncée de 544 kg, il y a certainement une erreur. Il doit plutôt s'agir de 544 livres, soit environ 250 kg. Pour le reste, ce produit est vraiment excellent. Certaines manœuvres, notamment en marche arrière, peuvent être difficiles à réaliser pour une personne. En marche avant, en revanche, aucun problème! Je pense sincèrement que c'est l'un des meilleurs achats que j'aie faits à ce jour. Et si je vous précise que j'ai quitté mon fauteuil roulant il y a un an, vous comprendrez sans doute pourquoi j'accorde autant de valeur à ce produit. Ce qui peut sembler anodin pour certains représente pour moi une aide particulièrement précieuse.

It’s a great sturdy cart seems to be very well-made easy to assemble. I guess my only complaint would be. It doesn’t have the turning diameter radius of the gorilla cart but it’s not as expensive as the gorilla cart so I can deal with that.
Bought a month ago. Easy to assemble. We'll worth the money use it all time. You can pull it around or hook it to your riding lawn mower.

Purchased the 800 lb. capacity Vevor Garden Dump Cart which was very well packaged with fast shipping and delivery from UPS. Contrary to other reviews, the instructions were complete and logical, allowing the cart to be easily assembled, if you have a little mechanical aptitude and take your time. The Cart frame is welded / bolted all steel construction providing a heavy duty foundation for for the poly dump cart. The 10 inch rubber tires on steel wheels allows the cart to roll smoothly on a variety of surfaces for outstanding mobility. The cart is heavy duty and capable of handling 800 lbs., but at only weighing 40 lbs., it's easy enough to hang up and get out of your way when not in use.
Very nice quality. Good design. Seems very sturdy.

I bought this several months ago and its been very helpful for hauling stuff like weeds, stones, mulch etc during landscaping. Its easy to roll, pull and unload vs a wheelbarrow. Very handy! I Highly recommend it as a utility tool.

I purchased this baby on 9/16/2026. I assembled amd used it on 10/5/2026. Let me tell you. This equipment / tool is ALL THAT!

Love it! Its not a wheelbarrow it's not a wagon it's better,doses everything you could need in the yard.you can haul with it you can put dirt or rocks and the dumping mechanism is great,so much easier. It's sturdy,I would buy again but looks like this one is going to last long time.very happy with this purchase.

I purchased this at the end of Aug 2026. Received item within a week. Waiting for me when I came in for the week. It came with assembly instructions that was very helpful in assembling it. The assembly would have been easy without the instructions but it shown you steps in order to take that made it much easier. I purchased the 800lbs model. It's very sturdy and and strong from seems capable of the 800lbs it's rated. The cart bucket not so. It's a little flimsy and if much wait was to sit on it the wrong way it would probably break easy. I've just poured a concrete patio last week and was pouring my concrete in a little tray I purchased to move the concrete to my forms. I used it for a little while struggling moving it to where I needed. Remember my purchase from Vevor i decided to try the work cart. I was getting a bag a a half in my try struggling all the way. The with the cart i was able to put my complete mixer in 4.5 cubic feet about 200lbs with still more room. It pulled and rolled easily and smooth. Better than any wheelbarrow I've used. Stood up steadily and nit once tried to tip. Definitely impressed. Happy with my purchase T.

We purchased this heavy duty garden cart in August to help us with a 2 acre landscaping project at our home. It attaches easily to the back of our ride on mower. It works perfectly to hold rocks and heavier items from one end of the property to the other. The tipping ability makes short work of unloading. My husband praises It is as a sturdy & well built wagon.

This Vevor garden cart is really going to help me around my yard. The cart arrived within days of placing my order. It was packed nicely with all parts padded and wrapped for protection. Instructions were clear and the cart came with all tools needed for assembly. It was easy to assemble and only took this 74yr old granny 45 min. to assemble even with schnauzer interruptions for periodic inspection and treats. I ordered the 600 lb. cart and it’s big enough for all my needs. I love the way the cart maneuvers and the dumping ability. The only downside to this cart for me is that the carts plastic bed is not as thick as I would have liked and seems a little flimsy compared to the carts heavy duty frame and tires. All in all I’m glad that I opted for this beautiful garden cart instead of a wheelbarrow.
